# Contract — SpriteKiln Art Briefs
*Generated by spec-writer. Regenerate on scope changes instead of hand-editing.*

## Definition of Done

Pipeline:
- [ ] `SpritekilnBriefSchema`, `SPRITEKILN_KITS` and `requiredAnimations` defined; tested with plain objects, no mocks
- [ ] `AssetEntrySchema` in the new shape; fixture updated; `npm run build:schema` regenerated and committed
- [ ] Art sends text only, returns briefs, derives paths in code, and re-validates resume entries
- [ ] `sharp` and the frontend images path are gone from Art and from package.json
- [ ] `IArtSpecWriter` port with exactly one adapter (`FileArtSpecWriter`), wired by hand in the CLI
- [ ] Stubs written only by `execute()` after validation, never by `executeDraft()`
- [ ] Every phase written test-first, one commit per phase
- [ ] AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, README and `.env.example` updated; the no-tool-loop rule kept

Evals:
- [ ] `:art` case judges `assets[].brief` with `art_brief_actionability`

Art workspace:
- [ ] `mmorpg-art` exists with `spritekiln==0.4.0` pinned, `init --engine godot --ai claude` exporting into `mmorpg-client`, a recorded style (topdown, 8 dirs, 64 px frames), and a README runbook
- [ ] The player layer spike's outcome is recorded in spec.md
- [ ] Player layers (or the fallback sheets) and the 22 + 14 backfill sprites are exported into the client

## Acceptance Criteria

| # | Side | Given | When | Then | Covered by |
|---|------|-------|------|------|------------|
| AC1 | Pipeline | a brief with base `humanoid`, head, 2 kits, 3 mustKeep, 3 palette | `SpritekilnBriefSchema` parses it | parsing succeeds | `src/domain/value-objects/spritekiln-brief.value-object.test.ts` |
| AC2 | Pipeline | a brief with kit `lightsaber`, or the same kit twice, or 1 mustKeep | it is parsed | parsing fails | `src/domain/value-objects/spritekiln-brief.value-object.test.ts` |
| AC3 | Pipeline | kind `npc` / `monster` | `requiredAnimations` runs | `[idle, walk]` / `[idle, walk, attack, hit, death]` | `src/domain/value-objects/spritekiln-brief.value-object.test.ts` |
| AC4 | Pipeline | a story with npcs and monsters and a fake client | Art generates | no request contains an `image_url` part; each entry has `source: "spritekiln-spec"`, its brief, `specPath` `art-specs/<npcs\|monsters>/<id>/<id>.yaml`, and `sourceDetail` = `brief.summary` | `src/infrastructure/agents/openrouter-art-agent.test.ts` |
| AC5 | Pipeline | the model first returns humanoid-without-head / none-with-kits / BOSS sized `small` / wrong entityId | Art generates | a corrective retry happens and the second, valid answer is used | `src/infrastructure/agents/openrouter-art-agent.test.ts` |
| AC6 | Pipeline | a resume with one old-shape entry and one new-shape entry | Art generates | the old one gets a model call and is replaced; the new one gets none and is kept | `src/infrastructure/agents/openrouter-art-agent.test.ts` |
| AC7 | Pipeline | a humanoid entry with kits `sword`, `hood` | `renderSpritekilnStub` runs | the output equals the golden: `spritekiln: 1` first, `extends: humanoid`, both kits under `use`, and `animations` from `requiredAnimations` | `src/infrastructure/persistence/spritekiln-stub.test.ts` |
| AC8 | Pipeline | a `none`-base entry | `renderSpritekilnStub` runs | no `extends` and no `use` lines | `src/infrastructure/persistence/spritekiln-stub.test.ts` |
| AC9 | Pipeline | a summary containing `: ` and `"` | `renderSpritekilnStub` runs | it is emitted as a JSON-quoted scalar (escaped) | `src/infrastructure/persistence/spritekiln-stub.test.ts` |
| AC10 | Pipeline | two entries and a temp output root | `FileArtSpecWriter.write` runs | both files exist at `<root>/<cityId>/<specPath>` and the returned paths match | `src/infrastructure/persistence/file-art-spec-writer.test.ts` |
| AC11 | Pipeline | a valid run | `execute()` finishes | the spec writer is called once with the validated assets | `src/application/use-cases/orchestrate-content-generation.use-case.test.ts` |
| AC12 | Pipeline | a `--skip-art` run, or a package that fails validation | `executeDraft()` / `execute()` runs | the spec writer is never called | `src/application/use-cases/orchestrate-content-generation.use-case.test.ts` |
| AC13 | Evals | a manifest with assets in the new shape | `npm run eval` | the `:art` case is built from `brief` and scored by `art_brief_actionability` | `manual: npm run eval on a golden with assets; the report lists <city>:art with the new metric name` |
| AC14 | Art workspace | the stubs from one real `npm run generate` copied into `mmorpg-art/art/specs/` | `spritekiln validate` on a humanoid NPC stub | it validates with no errors | `manual: Phase 6 step 2` |
| AC15 | Art workspace | one humanoid NPC and one `none`-base monster stub | Claude Code models, renders and exports them in mmorpg-art | `mmorpg-client/assets/spritekiln/<id>/` holds the atlas PNG + JSON, `.tres` and `.tscn` with the required animations, in the recorded style | `manual: Phase 6 step 2, check the JSON's animation tags and the preview GIFs` |
| AC16 | Art workspace | body, clothing, hat and sword layers on one skeleton | stacked in Godot, stepping idle/walk/attack in 8 directions | the layers stay aligned on every frame, or the fallback is recorded | `manual: Phase 7 step 2, screenshots per direction` |
| AC17 | Art workspace | the backend's current `monsters.image` and `npcs.image` names | the backfill is exported | each name has an `assets/spritekiln/<name>/` folder in the client | `manual: Phase 8 step 2 (a SQL list diffed against the folder names)` |

## Quality Gates
Pipeline: `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build:schema` (a committed diff is expected in this feature only).
Evals: `npm run eval` on a golden with assets.
Art workspace: `spritekiln validate` + `spritekiln render` + `spritekiln export` on the two Phase 6 assets.
